Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report (2412.19437v1) · paper method: In the DeepSeek-V2.5 distillation ablation, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 74.6 to 83.2 while average response length rises from 769 to 1,510.

cohort5.claim.deepseekv3.distill-tradeoff

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • This is the report’s V2.5 ablation, not a direct causal estimate for the final V3 system. Length units are not named in the cited table.
